hypothesis: I013 showed that the existing qualified Timoshenko/Cowper 0.53 frame kernel removes most of source-4's CAESAR-endpoint transverse constitutive residual while leaving local axial response unchanged. If missing transverse shear deformation is a genuine straight-pipe formulation defect rather than a source-4 coincidence, the same replay must improve the broader population of plain single-descendant FRAME sources when compared in each element's local basis.
predictedSignature: The locked baseline is expected to contain 55 qualifying plain FRAME sources in each case, with 50 sources length >=0.01 m and five sub-0.01 m spans reported separately rather than excluded.

For the 50 >=0.01 m sources in L19, pre-run replay predicts local transverse RMS residual about 1080.34 -> 21.79, maximum absolute residual about 9010.97 -> 210.46, and all 400/400 local FY/FZ/MY/MZ end-action components improving with zero regressions.

No bend, Bourdon, pressure, thermal authority, global solve, tolerance, or production mechanics are changed.

decisionReason: Locked run 31306028750 produced evidence fnv1a64:7ed521d0ee654c46 and independently reproduced the predeclared population signature. Each case had exactly 55 qualifying plain FRAME sources: 50 with length >=0.01 m and five shorter spans reported separately. For the 50 ordinary sources, L19 local transverse RMS residual fell 1080.3421583883319 -> 21.786758175246142 and max absolute residual 9010.974829905086 -> 210.45807053128647; all 400/400 local FY/FZ/MY/MZ end-action components improved, zero worsened, and all 50 source RMS values improved. L20 ordinary RMS fell 4824.048331512231 -> 66.34952465327605 and max 37970.26085148891 -> 615.8372949357217, again 400/400 improved and zero worsened. Maximum local axial and torsion residual deltas were exactly zero in both cases. The five sub-0.01 m spans also improved 40/40 with zero regressions, although their residual magnitudes remain large; therefore I014 provides no basis for a fitted production length cutoff. This confirms the missing-transverse-shear hypothesis broadly enough to authorize I015 as a system-level A/B using the existing governed Timoshenko/Cowper authority on plain FRAME elements only. It does not yet authorize a production merge, bend changes, thermal changes, or tolerance changes.
